liebermann.description_de: British Museum Cotton Tiberius B VIII
liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: London, British Library, Cotton MS Tiberius B.viii
liebermann.notes: Pontifical (ff. 1–33, c. 1150) for a suffragan of Canterbury, later owned by Glasgow; bound into it is a coronation order written in 1365 for Charles V of France after early Anglo-Saxon formulas; then again c. 1150 the Duel (f. 152v) and Iudicium Dei XI (with II 2–5,3), XII, XIII, XIV. Most closely related to Vt 2 and Mg.
